noSessionAvailable: No spelling session is available yet. Please check again in a little while.
csvColumns: CSV columns: grade, week, category, word, order, definition
importedWords: Added {{inserted}} new words and updated {{updated}} existing words.
importAlreadyApplied: This spelling word import was already applied.

emailFormalTestWordList: Email the planned test words for preparation
noPrepWordsToEmail: This student has no unresolved missed words yet, so there is no preparation word list to email.

classStopped: Created {{count}} sessions before the class operation stopped.

listenCarefully: Listen carefully and type the word you hear.
skippedWordsFollowUp: The student skipped these words. Read them aloud during follow-up.

replaceExistingList: Replace the existing word list for the grades in this file
replaceExistingWarning: All current words for these grades are removed and replaced by this file. Students' completed history and reports are kept, and words that appear in both lists are not asked again. End active sessions for these grades first.
replacedWords: Word list replaced: {{inserted}} new, {{kept}} kept, {{removed}} old words removed.
noMissedWordsInFilter: No missed words match these filters.

invalidImportOrder: Order must be a positive whole number.
duplicateImportPosition: The grade, week, and order combination is duplicated in the file.
waitingForNextWord: Waiting for the next word from your teacher…
handIsRaised: Your hand is raised. Your teacher will help you soon.
needHelpHint: Can't hear properly or need help? Raise your hand.
browserVoiceFallback: That clip isn't available right now, so the browser read the word aloud.
browserVoiceUnavailable: This browser cannot read the word aloud.
exampleUnavailable: That example isn't available right now.
pasteBlockedHint: Type only what you hear. Pasting and right-click are turned off for this test.
practicePassageHint: These are the target words to practice. This is practice material, not a grade.
hiddenPageNotice: During a spelling session, this page records when it becomes hidden, so your teacher can see it. Switching tabs or minimizing the browser counts as hidden.
leavingRecordedNotice: Leaving this spelling session page was recorded.

audioAdmin.title: Spelling audio
audioAdmin.searchTitle: Manage AI pronunciation and test audio
audioAdmin.searchDescription: Search for a spelling word to hear its generated AI clips, test playback, and remove or regenerate each accent. AI clips are shared across schools, so a change affects every school using the word.
audioAdmin.searchMin: Enter at least 2 letters to search for a word.
audioAdmin.aiLoadError: Unable to load AI word audio.
audioAdmin.sharedNote: These clips are shared across every school. Removing or regenerating one changes it for all schools that use the word.
audioAdmin.removedNote: Removed. Students hear the browser voice for this accent until you regenerate it. It will not be recreated automatically.
audioAdmin.generateHint: Generate a single clip here, or generate missing clips per grade in the AI word audio card below.
audioAdmin.testChecking: Checking that this server delivers the clip…
audioAdmin.testTimeout: The clip did not start within 8 seconds.
audioAdmin.testMediaError: The browser could not play this clip (media error {{code}}).
audioAdmin.testMediaErrorGeneric: The browser could not play this clip.
audioAdmin.testHttpError: The server answered HTTP {{status}}, so this clip is not being served. Address: {{url}}
audioAdmin.testServerUnknown: the server check could not run in this browser, so playback is the test
audioAdmin.testOk: Working. The browser started this clip in {{ms}} ms and the server sent {{serverNote}}. Students hear exactly this clip.
audioAdmin.confirmRemove: Remove the {{accent}} for “{{word}}”? AI clips are shared across schools, so this affects every school using the word. The clip stops playing everywhere and will not be recreated until you regenerate it. The other accent is not affected.
audioAdmin.confirmRegenerate: Generate a new {{accent}} clip for “{{word}}”? AI clips are shared across schools, so the new clip replaces the current one for every school using the word. Generation is charged to this school's AI credits. The other accent is not affected.
audioAdmin.removeSuccess: Removed the {{accent}} for “{{word}}” from shared spelling audio. It will not play or be recreated until you regenerate it.
audioAdmin.removeError: Unable to remove the AI clip.
audioAdmin.regenerateSuccess: Generated a new {{accent}} clip for “{{word}}”. Students now receive the new recording, even if their browser cached the old one.
audioAdmin.regenerateError: Unable to generate a new AI clip. The existing clip was not changed.
audioAdmin.regenerateUnavailable: Generating is unavailable while AI word audio is off for the platform.
audioAdmin.batchError: Unable to generate AI word audio.
audioAdmin.replacementHelper: Use an HTTPS audio link from Longman, Oxford, or Merriam-Webster.
audioAdmin.providerWarning: Enter an HTTPS audio link from Longman, Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries, or Merriam-Webster.
audioAdmin.confirmRemoveExample: Permanently remove this {{dictionary}} example recording for “{{word}}”? This changes the shared spelling audio for every school. Pronunciation audio is not affected.
audioAdmin.confirmReplaceExample: Replace this {{dictionary}} example for “{{word}}” with the previewed link? This changes shared spelling audio for every school.
audioAdmin.exampleRemoveSuccess: Removed the {{dictionary}} example for “{{word}}” from shared spelling audio.
audioAdmin.exampleRemoveError: Unable to remove the example audio.
audioAdmin.exampleReplaceSuccess: Updated the {{dictionary}} example for “{{word}}” in shared spelling audio.
audioAdmin.exampleReplaceError: Unable to replace the example audio.
audioAdmin.importDescription: Columns: word, status, first week. Optional: definition, and Longman/Oxford/Webster/Google example 1, example 2, … (audio URLs; several URLs in one cell can be separated by |). Pronunciation columns are ignored: pronunciation is generated AI audio. Empty cells never erase existing data. Preview first; nothing is saved until you press Import.

report.rowsWithAudio: Rows with at least one URL
report.wordsNotFoundInApp: Words not found in the app

audioAdmin.coverageDescription: The grade switch controls example recordings only. AI pronunciation clips are not affected by it. Off by default.
audioAdmin.aiDescription: Pronunciation clips are generated once, stored in our database, and reused for every school. Students never call AI; they play the stored clip. Generation is charged to this school's AI credits. Removed clips are never recreated by bulk generation.
audioAdmin.aiForcedOffNote: AI word audio is turned off on this server. Nothing can be generated or played until it is enabled there.
audioAdmin.aiOnNote: AI word audio is on for every school. Generated clips play automatically; you do not need to enable anything here.
audioAdmin.aiOffNote: AI word audio is off for every school. A super admin turns it on from AI Credit; schools cannot change it.
audioAdmin.aiPlatformAlert: AI word audio is controlled by the platform. Ask a super admin to turn it on in AI Credit, under AI word audio.
audioAdmin.aiTestHint: To test what a student hears, search a word above and press “Test playback” beside its AI US or AI UK clip. It plays that exact clip and reports whether this server delivered it, so a silent failure can no longer pass as a working clip.
audioAdmin.aiCoverageAria: AI word audio coverage by grade
audioAdmin.importFirst: Import spelling words first; there is nothing to generate yet.
